title: Small-N Testing and Design Claims
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting small-n testing and design claims to moderated usability test script with observation-to-revision trace, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Explain why small-N moderated testing is strong for surfacing usability problems but weak for outcome claims.
Convert an overreaching efficacy claim into a scoped problem-and-revision claim the sample can support.
Use observation frequency (e.g., 4 of 5) to prioritize revisions and to flag low-frequency signals for watching rather than acting.
Reject outcome language ("improves learning") when no comparison or baseline exists.
